Case ID: 1071
Case Type: HR Request
Date: 2025-03-20
Handled By: HR - Monique Carter
Customer or Requestor: Internal Employee - Ava Lin
Title: Parental leave coordination with payroll adjustments

Issue Description
Employee requested guidance on parental leave dates, benefit deductions, and return-to-work expectations before the expected birth date.

Steps Taken
- Reviewed tenure and location-based eligibility requirements in the leave administration policy.
- Scheduled a planning call with the employee and manager to align expected leave dates and temporary coverage.
- Coordinated with Payroll to explain how paid and unpaid portions of leave would affect deductions.
- Documented required certification timelines and return-to-work communication steps in the HRIS case.

Resolution
Approved the leave plan, provided a written summary of pay treatment and documentation deadlines, and aligned the employee, manager, HR, and Payroll on next actions.

Follow-Up
HR added a reminder to confirm the actual leave start date once the employee notified the team of the birth.

Reference Documents
- Employee Leave Administration Manual
- Leave Request Processing Runbook v1
